findings.claim: The 'First Formalizable Statement' (Linked Joint Rank-Trace Lemma) is FALSE as stated — a 2x2 counterexample violates it — and the repaired version reduces to the existing rank_trace_mult_k with no new algebra, changing the certificate arithmetic that M3's targets assume.
findings.argument: The stated lemma: P = sum_j m_j v_j v_j^dagger (m_j >= 1), P' >= sum_j (m_j-1) v_j v_j^dagger (PSD order), n_+(Q) <= b, n_+(Q') <= b', then 2c*tr((P+Q)+t(P'+Q')) - ||(P+Q)+t(P'+Q')||_F^2 <= sum_j k_c(m_j + t(m_j-1)) + c^2(b+b') + interference. Counterexample: one atom, m_1 = 1, v unit; P = vv^dagger; P' = uu^dagger with u orthogonal to v, unit (this is exactly a generic Rolle-forced on-line xi'-zero in a neighboring cell, so it is THE typical configuration, not an exotic one); Q = Q' = 0, b = b' = 0; all interference terms vanish (u ⊥ v, no blocks). Take c = 2, t = 1: H = vv^dagger + uu^dagger, LHS = 2*2*2 - 2 = 6; RHS = k_2(1+0) = 1*(4-1) = 3. 6 > 3. The bug: PSD xi'-mass NOT located at xi-multiples (the minorant constrains P' only from below) adds up to 2c*w - w^2 <= c^2 per orthogonal atom to the LHS with zero charge on the RHS. Since N_{xi'} ~ N, the true configuration carries ~N such uncharged atoms — the lemma fails by Theta(N). The repair is forced and unique: charge every xi'-atom its own k_c(t*m'_sigma) — but then the 'linked lemma' is literally rank_trace_mult_k (already in the repo, arbitrary real weights) applied to the combined atom list of H_t; the 'only new algebra' claim evaporates, and the (1+t)-trace budget the Mechanism section spends is mostly consumed by the generic xi'-population's own charges (~N*k_c(t)). All M3 constants (N_d >= 5/6 + eta, s_{2+} <= eps*N) are currently backed by an invalid inequality and must be re-derived after repair; whether anything positive survives is exactly the M4 LP question, currently open.

findings.claim: The organizing 'arithmetic de Branges / tilt-jet' identity chain is a verified conflation: the first tilt-jet is depth-weighted xi-ZERO data (the paper's own nu_X), not the xi'-ZERO data the certificate consumes; the claimed Krein-Langer multiplicity-visibility is never inherited by anything the certificate reads; and K_{1/2} is identically zero, making the phase-branch claim vacuous as stated.
findings.argument: Three checkable defects. (a) Conflation, confirmed against tx_048: the transcript's delta-tilt record states that d/da log|xi(a+it)/xi(1-a+it)| at a=1/2 'identifies the diagonal K_{1/2,X}(x,x) of the truncated kernel with nu_X — the same object as R4's signed density'. nu_X is the xi-zero density (poles of xi'/xi at xi-zeros, WeilEF/XiLogDeriv layer) — data the paper ALREADY consumes. The certificate's G' is the Weil form of xi' (poles of xi''/xi' at xi'-zeros, XiPrime/FGL layer). These are different analytic objects with different zero sets; the proposal's load-bearing sentence 'the j=1 layer is ALREADY FORMALIZED (Zeta23/XiPrime/ExplicitFormula)' attaches the jet to the wrong repo component. A kernel built from the FUNCTIONS xi, xi' is not a correlation of the ZEROS of xi with the ZEROS of xi'; no identity bridging jet-data to xi'-zero-data is stated or known. (b) Multiplicity-visibility: kappa_a = N(beta > a) with multiplicity is a property of K_a at fixed a > 1/2; the kappa_a jumps occur at a = beta_rho and are NOT locally readable from finitely many a-derivatives at a = 1/2 (reading them would be off-line-zero detection — the campaign's visibility/interference wall). No Krein-Langer theory for the jet kernel is stated, cited, or known. The certificate's actual multiplicity sensitivity comes solely from elementary calculus (xi' has an (m-1)-fold zero at an m-fold zero of xi) plus Rolle — true but de-Branges-free. (c) At a = 1/2, E_{1/2} = E^#_{1/2} identically, so the numerator of K_a vanishes for ALL (w,z), i.e. K_{1/2} ≡ 0 — not merely 'on the diagonal' as the Mechanism text says; hence the M5 phase-branch claim that warped-sinc 'is a compression of K_{1/2}, which is the right object' is a compression of the zero operator as written (must be the renormalized jet, an unproven substitute). Net: the operative mathematics (mixed moment + L1/L2 links) stands on its own; the thesis, the novelty claim (2), and the M5 'arithmetic canonical-system jets' horizon rest on an unsound identification.

findings.claim: The program-decisive numeric test measures the wrong null: R compares forced-coincidence signal to GUE background FLUCTUATION, but the certificate fights the worst-case joint law, whose background can be shifted at first order; a per-cell slack estimate indicates the adversary can fully absorb the doubles signal, so the likely M4 verdict is eta ~ 0 and M3 dies.
findings.argument: A certificate must hold configuration-by-configuration, so its strength is the LP over ALL joint (xi, xi')-laws matching the five computed values plus L1/L2 — not statistical detectability against GUE. Estimate of the adversary's slack: normalized mixed Fejer kernel for a flat-ish window is ~sinc^2(L*Delta/2); mean gap g = 2*pi/log(T/2pi) gives L*Delta = lambda*pi at a Rolle-cell midpoint, so the per-adjacent-pair kernel ranges over [sinc^2(pi/2), 1] ≈ [0.405, 1] at lambda = 1. Each of ~(2/3)N Rolle cells carries a mandatory on-line xi'-zero whose two adjacent-pair contributions are tunable over ~1.2 units total; aggregate slack ~0.8N units. The forced signal from (1/6)N on-line doubles is 2 units each (m*m'*|kernel(0)| = 2*1*1), total ~0.33N. Slack exceeds the signal by ~2.5x, and the adversary retains a further ~N/3 free xi'-zeros (N' ~ N minus interlacing-forced) plus next-nearest-neighbor terms to simultaneously fit kappa' (the xi'-form factor, constrained only at bandwidth <= 1, where the 256-law construction already demonstrates massive configurational freedom for a single object). So a doubles-heavy law can plausibly match tr G', ||G'||_F^2, tr GG', Rolle, and counting exactly — meaning the mixed-moment VALUE does not exclude the excess-N/6 world and the joint ceiling stays at ~5/6 / 0.6818. Consequence for the numerics: test (2)'s decision rule 'R >= 2 => Milestone 3 is live' is invalid — R measures fluctuation-scale detectability while the relevant comparison is the O(1)-per-cell adversarial background shift; test (3) probes only two extremal configurations at three depths, not the polytope. Repair: run a coarse adversarial placement-LP (minimize background over Rolle-admissible xi'-positions at fixed xi-layer and fixed kappa') BEFORE any M3 investment, and gate on that number instead of R.

findings.claim: Two headline overclaims: (a) the asserted upper bound on TOTAL multiplicity excess ('both on- and off-line multiples are forced by L1 into the mixed moment') is unsupported — L1 buys nothing for off-line multiples at the certificate level; (b) advertising s_1 gains ('any s_1 gain beyond 0.6725/0.6818 breaks the bandwidth-one ceiling legitimately') contradicts the proposal's own depth-0 mimicry admission.
findings.argument: (a) For an off-line multiple rho (m >= 2), the derived xi'-zero at the same off-line point contributes an indefinite hyperbolic pair-block to Q', not a PSD atom to P' — the proposal's own Lean-hook lemma confirms this by restricting the minorant to atoms v_j of P (on-line). In the only interference-robust treatment (inertia/block pricing), a Hermitian block contributes at most 2c*lambda - lambda^2 <= c^2 per positive eigenvalue REGARDLESS of multiplicity — the formalized depth-blindness/'kappa counts distinct off-line zeros' facts — so off-line multiples are priced exactly as in the paper's existing Theorem C, with zero new leverage from the mixed moment. The termwise mixed product of two aligned hyperbolic blocks IS positive (~m(m-1)*X^{2y}-scale), but reading it termwise is precisely what the X^{2y} blowup and the -4A^2 quadrupole cancellation forbid (the proposal's own failure mode 2). Hence the honest deliverable shrinks to ON-line multiple mass (s_{2+}) and on-line excess; the 'N - N_d with both on- and off-line multiples' phrasing in Mechanism and the M3 target list should be withdrawn. (b) For s_1: failure mode 3 concedes that a depth-0+ off-line pair with an adjacent on-line xi'-zero is CONTINUOUSLY indistinguishable from an on-line double in every consumed quantity (all five moments, L1 vacuous for simples, L2 satisfiable, separation degrading at (yL)^2). The lemmaR_tight extremal pair therefore persists inside the enlarged data class as a limit degeneracy; excluding the pairs-world by value-fitting fails because the adversary's free xi'-budget (~N/3 zeros) and Rolle-cell slack let it match all values (finding above). So no s_1 improvement should be expected from this route, and the Payoff section's bandwidth-ceiling-breaking language is marketing that the proposal's own failure-mode section refutes.

findings.claim: First Theorem (M1) is credible but carries three unflagged-or-underflagged technical exposures: mixed entry-error assembly, complex-argument tails for off-line xi'-zeros in the zero-side identity, and the w_J log-corrections at the endpoint lambda -> 1.
findings.argument: The prime-side evaluation of tr(G_hat G_hat') needs sum_{k,l} |main_{kl}|*err'_{kl} + err_{kl}*|main'_{kl}| + err*err' = o(N) — a new assembly over the XiPrime entry errors crossed with the paper's, not a verbatim re-run; the zero-side 'exact Poisson' identity holds literally only for real gamma, with off-line zeros of BOTH xi and xi' entering through Phi at complex arguments (e^{L*y}-growth) needing the Prop 4.2 tail run for the mixed kernel; and w_J(n) = Lambda(n)(1 + O(log n/log T)) means the correction is order ONE at n ~ X = (T/2pi)^lambda, lambda -> 1, so the mixed diagonal's main term and the MV absorption of the mixed off-diagonal must be checked at the endpoint (failure mode 4 concedes this; the fallback lambda < 1 fixed is fine). None of this is fatal: M1 is a plausible theorem-in-class, is genuinely a bilinear SECOND moment (so Rudnick-Sarnak k*lambda < 2 does not block it), and its claimed escapes from the formalized no-gos are formally sound — PairCeiling binds only single-form-factor linear certificates, the kappa >= 2/sqrt(3) cap is derived for two moments of ONE matrix, and lemmaR_tight's tightness is relative to an invariant list that excludes tr(GG'). M1 is the real value of the proposal.

findings.claim: The Krein-Langer premise itself is an unverified memory-recall with a finiteness gap: kappa_a = N(beta > a) 'over all heights' may be infinite, and the generalized-Schur/Hermite-Biehler status of E_a for a in (1/2,1) is exactly the flagged Lagarias recall — tx_048 says 'everything here is from memory, with no lookup'.
findings.argument: tx_048 records the Krein-Langer factorization claim for E^#_a/E_a and 'exactly kappa_a negative squares, kappa_a = N(beta > a) with multiplicity, over all heights' explicitly as an unchecked memory item. If RH fails with infinitely many off-line zeros of beta > a the kernel is not Pontryagin (kappa infinite) and the finite-negative-squares framing needs windowing that is never specified; and the unconditional structural facts cited (Lagarias 2005: E_a HB for a >= 1; HB for all a > 1/2 iff RH) are flagged-for-verification by the proposal itself. Since finding 2 shows the certificate never actually uses kappa_a, this does not damage M1-M4 — but it means even the motivational layer is built on an unverified recall, and any write-up must either verify Lagarias/Krein-Langer or drop the framing.

verdicts.repairs: Strip the de Branges dressing and restate the thesis as what it operationally is: an unconditional mixed (xi, xi')-zero cross-correlation theorem (M1) feeding a joint two-matrix certificate with elementary Rolle/derived-zero links — a de-conditionalization of the Farmer-Gonek-Lee mixed layer, not a jet-compression of K_a. Concretely: (1) Fix the M2 lemma by charging EVERY on-line xi'-atom its k_c(t*m'_sigma) price (after which it is rank_trace_mult_k on the combined atom list of H_t) and redo the LP arithmetic honestly; the claimed constants are currently backed by a false inequality. (2) Reorder gates: run the adversarial placement-LP (coarse M4) BEFORE M3, and replace numeric test (2)'s GUE-fluctuation null with a min-over-Rolle-admissible-placements computation; R-against-GUE is not a certifiability criterion. (3) Withdraw the off-line-multiple excess claim and the s_1/bandwidth-ceiling-breaking language; retarget on on-line multiple mass s_{2+} and on-line excess only, and present M1 + the joint-ceiling LP (M4) as the primary deliverables — M1 is a genuinely new, tractable, publishable unconditional theorem, and M4 extends the 256-law obstruction technology to derivative layers, which the field will pay for either way. (4) Correct the text errors: K_a's numerator vanishes identically (not just on the diagonal) at a = 1/2; the tx_048 identity ties the jet diagonal to nu_X (xi-zero data), so cite WeilEF/XiLogDeriv, not XiPrime, for the jet — and do not claim the certificate inherits Krein-Langer multiplicity-visibility. (5) Verify the flagged recalls (FGL id and w_J shape, Lagarias 2005, Ki 2008, Suzuki 2301.00421, the XiPrime ZeroCount statement) before any novelty or GUE-prediction claim is published. With these repairs the direction is a sound, honest, medium-payoff program: near-certain M1, a decisive machine-checked M4, and only a small residual chance that the joint LP leaves room for eta > 0 in multiplicity-specific bounds.
